rooms.name: Rootbound Entrance
rooms.composition: A winding arrival trail around a root arch, with a sheltered guide and waystone.

rooms.name: Fallen Idol Crossing
rooms.composition: A diagonal river, broad ruined crossing, and combat staging on the eastern bank.

rooms.name: Mosslight Clearing
rooms.composition: An open mushroom-lit clearing where two lower routes branch away from the sealed path.

rooms.name: Vine-Choked Gate
rooms.composition: A narrow root-framed approach to the living vine seal, with a small side clearing.

rooms.name: Whispering Hollow
rooms.composition: A winding corridor between two groves; casters flank its turns.

rooms.name: Overlook Bridge
rooms.composition: An aqueduct over deep water with two northern piers and an eastern landing.

rooms.name: Shrine of the First Seed
rooms.composition: A quiet circular stone courtyard around the First Seed altar.

rooms.name: Lantern Grotto
rooms.composition: A lantern alcove beside a crescent pool, reached along one tucked-away path.

rooms.name: Elder Roots Approach
rooms.composition: A bent root valley with a sheltered checkpoint before the crown arena.

rooms.name: The Hollow Crown
rooms.composition: A broad ruined circular court, with the crown roots framing its northern edge.

rooms.name: Lastlight Hamlet
rooms.composition: A sheltered hamlet with two timber houses beside a broad communal stone road.

rooms.name: The Silent Bell Archive
rooms.composition: A ruined bell archive with a stone reading court and a tucked-away memorial.

rooms.name: Emberwatch Observatory
rooms.composition: An observatory courtyard above the river where a lost ember is preserved.

rooms.name: The Drowned Gardens
rooms.composition: A flooded garden threaded by narrow stone paths between three planted islands.

rooms.name: The Root Cistern
rooms.composition: A root cistern with a sheltered central landing beside ancient waterworks.

rooms.name: Moonwell Sanctuary
rooms.composition: A moonlit well enclosed by a crescent pool, with a quiet outer ring.
